input.behavior_to_protect: A window where every value is None must produce no output entry rather than raising or returning null.

description: Write one regression scenario where every value in a window is None and the window must produce no output entry rather than raising or returning null. The scenario must fail a mutant that returns None for an all-missing window.
requirements: Return one JSON test scenario using only the supplied values. It must make the correct behavior pass and the named mutant fail.
